title: EnvOpt: Automated Optimization for Agent Environments
first_author_affiliation: University of California, Berkeley / University of Chicago / Bespoke Labs
code_status: 作者仓库公开 AutomationBench 环境产物，不等同于完整五组训练实现。
local_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -c 'from auto_research.agent_research.envopt import diagnostic; print(diagnostic(42))'

cost_assessment.available_resource: one NVIDIA A100 or A30, or local Mac
cost_assessment.model_scale: frontier research and target agents; AutomationBench uses Claude Opus 4.8 and Haiku 4.5
cost_assessment.data_scale: five settings; AutomationBench uses 200 test tasks and 96 validation tasks from 600 public tasks
cost_assessment.estimated_cost_basis: Reported Table 3 per-setting optimization cost including target runs: USD 33.08–339.44 and 3.7–25.4 hours. Not locally measured; full comparisons also require real environments and held-out evaluation.
cost_assessment.decision: 真实 API、多场景环境和小时级优化成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；只执行离线 CPU 决策回放。

summary: 固定模型与 Harness，在不提供训练 verifier 的互斥分片上改变环境表示；仅接受成本下降且代理保真的候选，若留出验证成本升或准确率降超容差则回滚。
fidelity_note: 仅回放 Algorithm 1 的候选选择与验证回滚，检查分片、固定 Harness 标识和验证结果绑定；不执行 Agent、预算执行器、环境编辑或 API，不宣称能力改善。
